complexity_ledger.narrative: Evidence, all under specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-03/: descriptor-coupling.md (the RD-03-DF-08 enumeration and its verdict), five-checks.md (the SV-04-DF-05 repair and the per-check ruling), four-results.md (all four standing results recomputed from the sealed cards), local-signal-apparatus-cut.txt, and the suite output. WHAT THE MACHINE-CHECKED CORE ABOVE CANNOT EXPRESS. THE COMPLEXITY DELTA IS ZERO AND THE LINE COUNT WENT UP. `examples/validation/` 14,685 -> 14,854 (+169); `scripts/` UNMOVED at 27,652; combined 42,337 -> 42,506; card unchanged at 6,281 bytes and digest sha256:2d7d4a0506d9b259. Reported per surface, never combined with the card. THIS TICKET MOVES GOAL-apparatus-cut THE WRONG WAY, by 169 lines, and it is the third epic running in which a ticket called a simplification came out net-additive -- which is RM-03-DF-03's structural point arriving on schedule. ZERO DELETIONS, SO CLAUSE (b) IS SATISFIED VACUOUSLY AND SHOULD BE READ THAT WAY. CA-03 deleted nothing, so there is no deletion without a finding behind it; that is not the same as having earned the clause. THE HALF OF THE BRIEF WITH NO LIVE SUBJECT. RD-03-DF-08 asked for the descriptor's role as a precondition of a D2 score to be cut. It was cut at card version 4 -- the card's own version-history row says so -- and what remains is either mandated by SERVED card rule 7 (which the acceptance freezes at 6,281 bytes), or a sealed reproduction bar protected by R-H4, or on the D3 axis carrying standing result 2. `grep -c code_complexity score_tools.py` is 0 and a repository-wide test has asserted the property since RD-05. So the answer is an enumeration and a verdict, not a diff. CA-03-DF-01. THE OTHER HALF IS ONE FAILURE, NOT FIVE. SV-04-DF-05 reads as an indictment of five checks. It is a defect in `scaffold`: it blinds `subject.name`, which is correct and is F3's first defence, and then does not record the [round-dir, arm-label] pair the blinding makes necessary. Repaired there -- the finding's own FIRST suggestion -- and not by the finding's second, which is to make `check` refuse and is a sixth gate. The repair refuses nothing. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE CHARTER THIS TICKET COULD NOT MAKE ITSELF. (1) "CL-01's second seal" is executed by `check` (version_history_problems, called from cmd_check and nowhere else), not by `seal`; a cut made on the charter's wording would remove the thing the charter protects. CA-03-DF-04. (2) "Static gates catch nothing -- seven epics, zero bugs" holds over subject code and fails over this project's own record, where `audit` alone has three dated, outcome-changing catches including the epic owner's own unexecuted R-H5, rejected at close within the minute. CA-03-DF-05, carried to CA-08. RAN MY OWN RULE AGAINST THE SEALED RECORD, PER THE CHARTER, AND `scope` REACHED NONE OF MY PROSE. `scope` reports 102 counted figures before and after these documents were written: not one claim in them takes the `D<n> = k on N of M` shape `scope` reads. That is a bound on `scope`, recorded rather than reported as a pass. The verification that did the work was reading each cited finding verbatim before resting anything on it, which is what caught that half this ticket's brief had already been done.

refinement.detail: SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, and the reason is that this ticket changes no model. CA-03's assignment declares `model_delta_expectation: none expected`; its ticket-local `current` and `desired` are byte-identical (`diff -rq` clean) and `specs/current/` is untouched on this branch. No action, variable or state is added to any TLA+ model, so there is no added representation to refine. A REFINEMENT RECOMMENDATION WAS AVAILABLE AND IS REFUSED RATHER THAN UNFOUND, and it is worth naming because it is the obvious move. The registration this ticket ships makes a blinded round self-describing, and the tempting next step is to MODEL the round lifecycle -- scaffold, blind, register, judge, check, seal -- so the missing registration becomes a state the model forbids. Refused on two grounds. First, this epic's instruction is NO NEW GATES, and a model that forbids the state is a gate wearing a proof. Second, and decisively, the defect was never that the state was unreachable in theory: it was that nothing WROTE a fact the scaffold already held. Adding representation to describe a bookkeeping omission is apparatus growth in an epic whose subject is the apparatus-to-result ratio. Filed here rather than acted on.

ticket.objective: TWO FINDINGS, ONE OWNER, BECAUSE BOTH LIVE IN score_tools.py. FIRST, RD-03-DF-08: on THE CLEAREST SIMPLIFICATION THIS PROJECT EVER MEASURED, 19 OF 21 DESCRIPTOR AXES WERE BYTE-IDENTICAL AND ONE MOVED THE WRONG WAY, while EIGHT JUDGES FOUND THE SIMPLIFICATION INDEPENDENTLY. The descriptor cannot see the one thing it was built to see. READ THE CONSTRAINT EXACTLY: analyze_complexity.py and code_complexity.py SERVE THE SPEC WORKFLOW AND STAY -- RM-02 was explicit about this and cutting them fails the ticket. What is cut is their ROLE AS A PRECONDITION OF A D2 SCORE. Find every place the descriptor's output gates, blocks, decorates or is required by a D2 scoring path and remove that coupling; the scripts keep running for the workflow that actually uses them. SECOND, SV-04-DF-05: check, seal, audit, contested AND derive ALL PASSED ON UNREGISTERED CARDS -- a live defect in the round's own output, and the only thing that caught it was a test behind a 21-minute suite. FIVE CHECKS PASSED A LIVE DEFECT. That is not an argument for a sixth check; it is an argument that these five are not doing the job they claim. Decide, on the record, whether each of the five EARNS ITS KEEP: seal, contested and the version/served double seal are on RM-02's do-not-cut list and CL-01's second seal caught a real class one ticket later, so the likely shape is REPAIR the registration hole and CUT what is left that has never caught anything. NO NEW GATES -- seven epics, zero bugs. PRICE BOTH CUTS. And run your own rule against the sealed record before shipping it, per the charter.
ticket.title: Stop the complexity descriptor being a precondition of a D2 score, and fix the five checks that passed a live defect
